🎥🎬: Atlanta (2016–2022)

Earnest “Earn” Marks is a young man trying to turn his life around while navigating the unpredictable world of Atlanta’s hip-hop scene. When he discovers that his cousin Alfred, also known as Paper Boi, is gaining attention as a rising rapper, Earn sees an opportunity to become his manager and help him achieve success.

Alongside Alfred, his eccentric friend Darius and the outspoken Van, Earn gets pulled into a world filled with bizarre encounters, industry politics, racial tensions and unexpected opportunities. But making it in the music business proves far more complicated than simply getting a rapper noticed.

As the characters chase money, fame and personal fulfillment, they encounter surreal situations that challenge their understanding of identity, relationships and society. Blending comedy, drama and social commentary, Atlanta explores the strange realities of trying to make it in a world where nothing is ever quite what it seems.
